managementOffice.hours: Conceptual office hours; no live staff schedule.

Structural openings, glazing, egress and shared circulation are not editable in this prototype.

modes.label: Respect the leased shell

modes.label: Freeform interior
modes.description: Let the creator imagine an interior beyond the shell dimensions; the lease still governs the exterior footprint and real-world safety constraints.

interior.dimensions: metres; authored conceptual values, not surveyed measurements

designModel.persistence: localStorage draft in this browser profile only
designModel.submission: No lease application, lease grant, payment, tenant account or shared publication is performed.

limitations: Vacant units are authored leasing fixtures, not live inventory or a binding offer.
The manager interaction is scripted demonstration content, not a live human, AI agent or SURPS-registered character.
Facade and interior edits are local design drafts and are not visible to other visitors.
Freeform interior mode is an expressive design option, not permission to alter the mall shell, structure, fire egress, accessibility, utilities or safety requirements.
No lease, payment, merchant registration, Economy account, catalog or inventory mutation is performed.
